description: This file contains helper functions for testing and creating memory tools and configurations for the openclaw project. It includes functions to create default configurations, generate tools with error handling, and assertions for unavailability scenarios.

methods.description: Casts a partial configuration object to a complete OpenClawConfig object.

methods.description: Creates a default OpenClawConfig with a main agent.

methods.name: export function createMemorySearchToolOrThrow(params?: { createMemorySearchToolOrThrow
methods.description: Creates a memory search tool with given parameters, throws an error if creation fails.

methods.name: export function createMemoryGetToolOrThrow( createMemoryGetToolOrThrow
methods.description: Creates a memory get tool with given configuration, throws an error if creation fails.
